meta.name: Bebas 2020
meta.description:
This is a political crime thriller and story of a honest police officer Ranvijay Singh.

Returning Series · First aired 28 Oct 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 19 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Shadyantra ya Sazish
videos.overview: A young politician Monika Devi whose victory is almost final suddenly kidnap by a unknown man. Opposition wanted to spoil her reputation so department transfer this case to a crime branch honest police officer Ranvijay Singh

videos.title: Gumrah
videos.overview: Kidnaper is a dumb man who put Monika Devi in a cage like animal. And now he torcher her mentally and physically. Here Ranvijay got to know that opposition is not behind this then who is....?

videos.title: Chehre Pe Chehre
videos.overview: Ranvijay investigate the case and he knew from his reliable sources where is Monika. He goes and kidnaper got killed. But when Ranvijay know the truth. He is completely shocked because the mastermind is no one but Monika Devi.

videos.title: Akhiri Faisla
videos.overview: We show real Monika how devil she is. Once again Ranvijay used by his department. He feels very helpless again because of this currupt system. Now he takes a hard decision and shoot Monika.
